$comment: Huawei AppGallery IAP products of Nibras QR — the ONE place to change product ids. Used by the app (src/mobile/purchases.huawei.ts) and by the Supabase edge functions (huawei-iap-verify / huawei-iap-notify). All are auto-renewable subscriptions in ONE subscription group ('Nibras QR Pro'); every product listed here unlocks Pro. The paywall skips products AppGallery does not return. priceSar is documentation only — real prices come from AppGallery.
